verses.text: Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Yuj wal to tzex hin xajanej hex aj Sion, yuj chi' manh ol hin em numan. Yuj wal to tzex hin xajanej hex aj Jerusalén, yuj chi' manh ol wik'laj wip masanto ol cheklajel he tojolal icha yik sk'inhib'i, haxo he kolnab'il, ol cheklajel icha yajoch sk'ak'al te' taj t'a k'ik' k'inal.
Masanil nación ol och k'elan yilan he tojolal. Masanil heb' rey, ol och k'elan heb' yilan sniwanil heyelk'ochi. Yuj chi' ol ak'chajoch junxo heyak' b'i. Ha hin Jehová hin tik ol wak'ochi.
Icha scheklajel sniwanil yelk'och junok winh rey yuj scorona, icha chi' ol aj wak'an cheklaj sniwanil welk'ochi, yujto ayex ek' t'a yol hin k'ab'.

Manhxo ol he kuch “Aktab'ilkani”, manhxo ol alchajpax t'a he lum tik, “Satb'ileli”, palta to ol he kuch: “Nib'ab'il”. Haxo lum he lu'um ol skuchkan: “Nupnajnak,” yujto nib'ab'il hex wu'uj. Yajal waj t'a lum he lu'um tik.

Yujto icha wal junok winh kelem snupnaj yet' junok ix kob'es, icha chi' ol hin aj heyet'ok, ol hin ochxok heyet'ok, ol hin tzalaj heyet'ok, icha stzalaj junok winh kelem yet' yetb'eyum, icha chi' ol hin tzalaj heyet'ok.
Hex aj Jerusalén, ix wak'kanoch he tanhwumal t'a yib'anh smuro'al he chonhab'. T'a k'uhal t'ak'wal ol yal heb' icha tik: Ha hex tzex awaj t'a Jehová, manh hex och wa'an heyawaj t'ay.
Manh he cha yik' yip Jehová, masanto ol sb'oxik'e Jerusalén tik, yik wach' masanil heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ay, xcham heb', xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová toxo ix yak' sti', ol yak'elk'och tas ix yal chi' yuj spoder. Ix yalan icha tik: Manhxa b'ak'inh ol hin cha swab'at he trigo heb' ajk'o'ol, manhok heb' ch'ok nacional ol uk'anb'at he wino, haton tastak tzeyik' t'a he munlajel.
Palta to ha hex wal ol he mol sat heyawb'en, ol he wa'ani, ol heyalan wach' lolonel t'ayin yuj. Ol he molanpax sat heyuwa, ol heyuk'an yal heyuwa chi' t'a yol yamak'il hin templo, xchi Jehová.

Hex aj Jerusalén, elanhek t'a spuerta'il he chonhab', b'o'ekb'at sb'e heb' heyetchonhab' wan sjaxi. Panhan tzeyutej b'aj ch'olkixtak, tzeyik'anel k'e'en k'e'en t'a yol b'e chi'. Tzeyak'ank'e junok bandera yik sch'oxan t'a juntzanhxo nación b'ajtil ay jun b'e chi'.
Ha Jehová tz'alan t'a heb' kajan b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik: Alek t'a heb' aj Sion icha tik: Ileknab' sjawi he Kolumal, yet'nak tas ix yik' yuj smunlajel, xe chi, xchi Jehová.
Ha heb' israel, ol alchajok to schonhab' Dios yaj heb', sik'b'ilel heb', haton masanil heb' ix kolji yuj Jehová. Ha Jerusalén ol skuch Chonhab' Nib'ab'il, Manhxo Aktab'ilokkani.
